metas.description: When a woman and her dog face public hostility, a village's hidden tensions erupt. A stark examination of mob mentality, social judgment, and how communities can turn cruel when seeking to punish perceived wrongs.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · Madhuvidhu
metas.description: When Amrutharaj, a groom from an all-male household repeatedly rejected by brides' families, falls in love with Sneha Marcose, their journey toward marriage ignites a chain of hilarious chaos inside his unruly home.

metas.name: ★ 5.1 · 2026 · Ashakal Aayiram
metas.description: A social media enthusiast chases fame until a major film production arrives in his neighborhood, suddenly bringing his dreams of stardom within reach in ways he never imagined.

metas.name: ★ 4.2 · 2026 · Maharaja Hostel
metas.description: A group of college students settle into what seems like an ordinary hostel, but things soon take a strange turn when a series of unexplained incidents begin to unfold. As their fun-filled hostel life descends into chaos, the students and their warden are forced to face the mysterious presence lurking within Maharaja Hostel.

metas.name: ★ 3.7 · 2026 · Bhishmar
metas.description: Two men meet by chance, setting off a night of chaos with romance and action, as their paths cross and intertwine through various unexpected events.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Dhoomakethu
metas.description: On the morning of his wedding, 36 year old Kuttan wakes from a disturbing dream about his own death. As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realizing that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself again.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2026 · Aashaan
metas.description: Aashaan dreams of cinema until a 150-member film crew enters his life, bringing movie magic within reach. Chasing his big break, he confronts the industry's harsh realities.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2026 · Spa
metas.description: The narrative follows the intertwined lives of people connected to La Paradise, an urban massage therapy centre. It centres on Mathan, a man struggling to distinguish between the reality of love and its fictionalised ideals. Through a sharp lens of social satire, the story explores adult themes and human behaviour within this unique urban setting.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Sarvam Maya
metas.description: A young Hindu priest's peaceful life is disrupted when he meets a spirit. What starts as a supernatural challenge evolves into a profound journey that tests his faith and makes him question everything he knows.

metas.name: ★ 4.3 · 2025 · Innocent
metas.description: Vinod, 29, is a man of routine. Living in Karunagappally and working at the Planning Office in Thiruvananthapuram, he spends his days in a carefully controlled cycle of train commutes, meticulous work, and an almost obsessive adherence to order.

metas.name: ★ 5.2 · 2025 · Odum Kuthira Chadum Kuthira
metas.description: When his fiancée's dream leads to an accident on his wedding day, Aby wakes up from a coma to find himself torn between the past and present.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2025 · Sahasam
metas.description: A man betrays his partner and disappears with money stolen from a cartel. Later, when the loot is invested in cryptocurrency, it becomes inaccessible due to a lost password.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2025 · Written & Directed by God
metas.description: A frustrated filmmaker meets God in person and goes on a transformative journey. When the deity appears to Jijo, they embark on an extraordinary road trip together.
